description: nf-core/methylseq samplesheet context for WGBS / RRBS / EM-seq analyses.

aligner.help: Alignment tool to use. The schema also lists 'bismark_hisat' and 'bwamem', which are not offered here: HISAT2 is for splice-aware RNA work, and bwamem is the TAPS aligner.

rrbs.help: Turn on if dealing with MspI digested material. Also makes the pipeline skip the deduplication step.

pbat.help: Preset for working with PBAT libraries.

cytosine_report.help: Output stranded cytosine report, following Bismark's bismark_methylation_extractor step.

pipeline.name: nf-core/methylseq
pipeline.core_rule: Required columns are: sample, fastq_1. fastq_2 is blank for single-end libraries; the optional genome column names a reference genome per row.

validation_rules: sample has no spaces; rows with the same sample value are re-sequenced runs of one sample, and the pipeline concatenates their reads before the alignment.
fastq_1/fastq_2 must be gzipped FASTQ files ending in .fastq.gz or .fq.gz; the pipeline detects single-end from a blank fastq_2.
genome is optional and per row; leave it blank and set the reference once for the run.
The library type (WGBS vs RRBS vs EM-seq vs PBAT) and the aligner (bismark vs bwameth) are set by pipeline params, not by the samplesheet.

population_priority: One row per library/run; combine lanes by repeating the sample value.
Carry NExtSEEK metadata into treatment/tissue/donor/condition columns.
